units.Amos 5:13: Therefore the understanding person will be silent at that time, because it is an evil time.
units.Amos 8:3: The temple’s coffered ceilings will wail. On that day,” says the Lord, “many have fallen in every place. I will cast silence upon them.”
units.Amos 5:10: They hated one who reproved at the gates and abhorred a holy word.
units.Amos 5:11: Therefore, because you struck the poor with fists and accepted choice gifts from them, you built houses of polished stone but certainly will not inhabit them; you planted desirable vineyards but certainly will not drink their wine.
units.Amos 5:12: For I knew your many impieties, and your sins are strong: trampling the righteous, taking payments and turning aside the poor at the gates.
units.Amos 5:14: Seek the good and not the evil, so that you may live; then the Lord God Almighty will be with you, just as you said,
units.Amos 5:15: “We have hated evil things and loved good things.” Restore judgment at the gates, so that the Lord God Almighty may have mercy on Joseph’s remaining ones.
units.Psalms 38:1: For the end. For Jeduthun. A song of David.
units.Psalms 38:2: I said, “I will guard my ways so as not to sin with my tongue.” I placed a guard upon my mouth when the sinner stood against me.
units.Psalms 38:3: I became mute and was humbled and kept silent from good things, and my pain was renewed.
units.Psalms 38:4: My heart grew hot within me, and in my meditation a fire will be kindled. I spoke with my tongue:
units.Psalms 38:5: “Make known to me, Lord, my limit and the number of my days, what it is, so that I may know what I lack.
units.Amos 8:1: The Lord showed me this: Look, a fowler’s vessel.
units.Amos 8:2: He said, “What do you see, Amos?” I said, “A fowler’s vessel.” The Lord said to me, “The end has arrived upon My people Israel. I will certainly no longer pass them by.
units.Amos 8:4: Hear these things now, you who wear out the needy until morning and oppress the poor out of the land,
units.Habakkuk 2:9: O you who acquire evil gain for your house, setting your nest on high to escape the hand of evils!
units.Habakkuk 2:10: You planned shame for your house, brought many peoples to an end, and your soul sinned.
units.Habakkuk 2:11: For a stone will cry from a wall, and a beetle from wood will utter these things.
units.Habakkuk 2:12: Woe to the one building a city with bloodshed and preparing a city with injustices!
